transport: OpenAI-compatible function calling. POST {"tool": str, "arguments": dict} to the endpoint.

function.name: get_system_status
function.description: Get the current macOS version, uptime, and live accessibility settings (pointer size, display contrast, VoiceOver, keyboard navigation) plus the active profile/theme and server info.

function.name: list_cursor_themes
function.description: List the available cursor themes (apple_cursor, high_contrast, large_pointer, remote_work_clear) with pointer size, contrast level, description, and source.

function.name: apply_cursor_theme
function.description: Apply a cursor theme by name. Applies the theme's pointer size and display contrast settings and marks it active.

theme_name.description: Theme name: apple_cursor, high_contrast, large_pointer, or remote_work_clear

function.name: list_accessibility_profiles
function.description: List the available macOS accessibility/remote-work profiles with their settings, the active profile, and remote-work mode state.

function.name: create_accessibility_profile
function.description: Create a custom accessibility profile. Only profile_name is required; any omitted setting is snapshotted from the current system state.

profile_name.description: Name for the new profile (max 64 chars, must be unique)

pointer_size.description: Pointer size between 0.5 and 3.0 (1.0 = system default)

voiceover_enabled.description: Whether applying this profile should enable VoiceOver

keyboard_navigation.description: Enable full keyboard navigation (Tab moves between all controls)

remote_work_mode.description: Mark this profile as a remote-work profile

function.name: apply_remote_work_profile
function.description: Apply an accessibility/remote-work profile by name. Sets pointer size, display contrast, keyboard navigation, enables VoiceOver when the profile requests it, and updates remote-work mode state.

profile_name.description: Profile name: Remote Work, Accessibility Power User, Developer Focus, High Contrast, or a custom profile

function.name: set_pointer_size
function.description: Set the macOS pointer/cursor size. Allowed range: 0.5 to 3.0 (1.0 is the system default).

function.name: set_display_contrast
function.description: Set display contrast. 'high' enables Increase Contrast + Reduce Transparency; 'max' additionally enables Differentiate Without Color; 'low'/'normal' restore the system baseline.

function.name: enable_voiceover
function.description: Enable the macOS VoiceOver screen reader (Cmd+F5). Safe to call when VoiceOver is already running - it will not toggle it off.

function.name: backup_macos_settings
function.description: Backup current macOS accessibility settings to ~/.macos-remote-work/backups/. Pass restore_from=<path to a previous backup .plist> to restore a backup instead.

restore_from.description: Optional: path to a previous backup .plist inside ~/.macos-remote-work/backups/ to restore
